name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She stands in a slinking, hip-shifted stance, one hand held out with fingers delicately curled releasing a tendril of toxic mist, the other held at her chest rolling a glowing droplet between her fingertips, chin lowered, a sly, knowing gaze to the camera. A swirling breeze moves her skirt, the mist and her hair. No weapon or staff - casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: Curling tendrils of {{MAGIC}} toxic mist coil around her hands and a glowing droplet hangs between her fingertips.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
